scripts.db:seed:local: tsx scripts/seed.ts > .wrangler/seed.sql && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file .wrangler/seed.sql
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB -c wrangler.jsonc --env staging --remote
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB -c wrangler.jsonc --env production --remote
scripts.db:seed:staging: tsx scripts/seed.ts > .wrangler/seed.sql && wrangler d1 execute DB -c wrangler.jsonc --env staging --remote --file .wrangler/seed.sql
scripts.db:prepare:e2e: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB -c wrangler.jsonc --env staging --local && tsx scripts/seed.ts > .wrangler/seed.sql && tsx scripts/e2e-accounts.ts >> .wrangler/seed.sql && wrangler d1 execute DB -c wrangler.jsonc --env staging --local --file .wrangler/seed.sql
scripts.deploy:staging: CLOUDFLARE_ENV=staging npm run build && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:production: CLOUDFLARE_ENV=production npm run build && wrangler deploy
